notes.subject: plate
notes.text: Long white front plates and yellow rear plates.

notes.subject: coverage
notes.text: Everything is Generation 4. The pickup is usually hidden by a big blur; when visible it is a large white or brown pickup with a brake light.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Coverage has a noticeable hazy tint, especially in the sky.

notes.subject: architecture
notes.text: Brick and concrete single-family houses with fairly steep roofs, fences, and decorative ventilation bricks in many walls.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Quite hilly but not very mountainous, with clearly red-tinted soil.

notes.subject: vegetation
notes.text: Eucalyptus trees are very common, along with banana plants throughout.

notes.subject: bollard
notes.text: Several styles of red and white cylindrical bollards, plus various white concrete waystones.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: Streets are noticeably clean and free of garbage.

notes.subject: line
notes.text: Kerbs are often painted with black and white stripes.

notes.subject: street
notes.text: Villa neighbourhoods have tall security fences and walls.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: Traffic drives on the right.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: All motorcyclists must wear red vests and helmets, so riders in red are everywhere.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: Coverage is limited to the capital and a few patches elsewhere; street names often start with a two-letter code for the district.

notes.subject: street
notes.text: Lampposts on many national roads carry the road number in black paint, with a lamp number below that usually rising away from the capital.

notes.subject: vegetation
notes.text: Tea plantations are common in the west and a few other pockets.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Volcanoes and volcanic rocks can be seen in the northwest.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: The northeast has gentler rolling hills, open farmland or undeveloped grassland.

notes.subject: street
notes.text: The big eastern park is vegetated yet dry, with wide reddish-brown unpaved roads, covered by the brown Google car.

notes.subject: vegetation
notes.text: The southwestern forest park has lush hilly terrain, a paved yellow road with lines and a mostly paved white road without lines.

notes.subject: street
notes.text: Many roads in the southern university town have cobblestone paving.
